description: The constant-0 and constant-1 colourings of singletons both make every infinite subset homogeneous, respectively in 0 and 1, while no single colour works for both.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.constant_colors_disagree (H : Set ℕ) (hH : H.Infinite) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn (fun x => 0) H 0 ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn (fun x => 1) H 1 ∧
      ¬∃ i,
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn (fun x => 0) H i ∧
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn (fun x => 1) H i
